This '''unidentified Imperial service droid''' was in the possession of an [[Unidentified Imperial scout|Imperial scout]]. When the scout was forced to make an emergency landing on [[Seoul 5]], the service droid repaired [[Imperial Exploratory Division craft|his ship]].
